related_questions.question: What does the COVID vaccine do to your body?

text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 vaccines work by training the body's immune system to recognize and fight the virus without causing illness. The vaccines introduce a harmless piece of the virus, like a spike protein, to the body. This triggers an immune response, causing the body to produce antibodies and activate immune cells to defend against a future infection. Side effects, like fever or fatigue, are normal signs that the body is building immunity, according to the CDC.
